talents.description: Gives you a {0}% chance to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike.  The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases resistance to Interrupt effects by {1}%.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
talents.description: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by {0}%.

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire
talents.description: Increases the effects of your Inner Fire spell by {0}%.

talents.name: Inner Focus
talents.description: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
talents.description: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by {0}%.

talents.name: Meditation
talents.description: Allows {0}% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Searing Light
talents.description: Your damaging Holy and Discipline spell critical strikes have a {0}% chance to cause your next Smite spell to be instant cast and cost 50% less mana.  Lasts 10 sec.

talents.name: Purifying Flames
talents.description: Your Holy Fire has a {0}% chance to increase your Holy damage by 12% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Mental Strength
talents.description: Increases your total Intellect by {0}% and your spell casting speed by {1}%.

talents.name: Enlighten
talents.description: Bring a party member under your tutelage for 30 min. Whenever you cast a Discipline or Holy spell, you have a 10% chance with helpful spells, or 15% chance with harmful spells, to burn them for 4% of their total health as Holy damage and increase both your and their spell damage and healing by 10% for 8 sec.  If cast on yourself, the spell damage and healing bonus is increased to 15%.  Only one party member can be under your tutelage at a time.

talents.name: Resurgent Shield
talents.description: When your Power Word: Shield is broken, 25% of its base mana cost is refunded and increases damage and healing done by Holy spells and effects by up to 10% of the shield's total absorption amount for 8 sec.

talents.name: Force of Will
talents.description: Increases your spell damage and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by {0}% and the amount of damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by {1}%.

talents.name: Chastise
talents.description: Chastise the target, causing 139 to 160 Holy damage.  If the target is an enemy, they are disoriented for up to 2 sec or until they take damage.  If the target is an ally, their attack and casting speed is increased by 13% for 8 sec, increased to 12 sec if the damage results in a critical strike.  Cannot be used on allies with less than 80% health or below level 35.

talents.name: Improved Renew
talents.description: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by {0}%.

talents.name: Holy Focus
talents.description: Gives you a {0}% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any Holy spell.

talents.name: Divinity
talents.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy and Discipline spells by {0}%.

talents.name: Divine Fury
talents.description: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal spells by {0} sec.

talents.name: Spell Warding

talents.name: Holy Reach

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
talents.description: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, heal {0}% of the damage taken over 6 sec.

talents.name: Holy Nova
talents.description: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 27 to 31 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 54 to 62. Using this spell while in Shadowform damages you instead of healing you. These effects cause reduced threat.

talents.name: Swift Recovery
talents.description: The amount healed by your healing spells is increased by {0}% if the target is affected by Renew.

talents.name: Improved Healing

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
talents.description: Increases spell damage and healing by up to {0}% of your total Spirit.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
talents.description: Increases total Spirit by 5%.  Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 10 sec.  The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, the priest dies.

talents.name: Reservoir of Light
talents.description: Increases the amount of charges on your Lightwell by {0}.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
talents.description: Increases the amount healed by your healing spells by {0}%.

talents.name: Proclaim Champion
talents.description: Proclaims a friendly target as your Champion for 2 hour, reducing all damage taken by 5% and increasing all resistances by 0. Allows the use of various Champion spells on that target. In addition, you gain Mana equal to 2% of the damage taken by your Champion. Only one Champion can be proclaimed at a time.

talents.name: Spirit Tap
talents.description: Gives you a {0}% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit after killing a target that yields experience.  For the duration, your Mana will regenerate at a 50% rate while casting.  Lasts 15 sec.

talents.description: Your Shadow damage spells have a {0}% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Shadow damage.  This vulnerability increases the Shadow damage dealt to your target by 3% and lasts 15 sec.  Stacks up to 5 times.
